name: 習得した内容から復習を選ぶ
prompt: Redesign the existing Japanese review-summary screen as a portrait mobile view matching the native preview exactly in crop, content and hierarchy. The native preview is authoritative for layout and Japanese text. The original Speak screenshot is secondary context for the course row and its embedded group photo; do not copy its blue bars or system status row. Use the attached user example only for palette preference: pure white surfaces, neutral borders and a solid green active state; do not copy its geometry. Keep the main review card and the lower listening-review card both white with thin neutral-gray outlines. Replace the lower pale mint fill with white. Use flat forest green for progress bars, primary review button and speaker icon; use neutral gray for dividers and secondary text. Preserve the circular group photo exactly as shown in the native preview: same people, scale, crop and position; do not redraw, recolor or retouch faces. Preserve exact Japanese copy: 習得したことを復習; 今回の内容をすべて習得しました。; 次のレッスンで新しい内容に進みましょう。; 自分のコースから; 1つの概念; 習得率：100%; はじめての会話・第1部; 100%; 次のおすすめの復習：364日後; 復習を始める; 聞き取りを復習; 学んだ内容を音声でもう一度. Preserve card sizes, spacing and all visible row positions. No pale tints, mint/cyan/blue fills, gradients, shadows, extra status bar or additional copy.
reviewNotes: White listening-review card with neutral outline replaces mint tint; forest green remains on progress, action and speaker. Photo and Japanese copy retained. Pending owner review.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
